info.title: Fintr Break-Even Tool API
info.description: REST API for the Fintr warehouse break-even tool (BFB 321, Group 9). All money is in ZAR. Log in with POST /api/auth/login, then send 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'. Errors always use the Error schema.

break_even_volume.description: Units/month where the warehouse becomes cheaper (null = never)

actual_demand.description: Fintr's real consumer demand from the orders table (only when the database is on)

monthly_volume.description: Defaults to the region's saved volume

ProductCreate.description: landed_cost_zar may not be lower than ex_factory_zar. The SKU is stored in capitals and must be unique.

ProductUpdate.description: landed_cost_zar may not be lower than ex_factory_zar. The SKU is stored in capitals and must be unique.

OrderCreate.description: The route must deliver to the order's region and the SKU must exist.

OrderUpdate.description: The route must deliver to the order's region and the SKU must exist.
